criteria.photon_materials: Photon and Faithful preserve warm oak, pale woven cloth, muted indigo and restrained copper; the controller reads as part of the bench rather than a separate modern panel.
criteria.scale_readability: At normal world distance the broad low bench and open loom frame remain distinct from the masonry Tannery and Smithy.
criteria.states_motion: The static assembly remains coherent while the existing controller fire/working state changes independently; the copper roller is deliberately static.
criteria.interaction_guides: The focused workshop scene assembles the real Part list and verifies completion, including shared-cell feet and upper slabs through the existing contextual guide system.
criteria.inventory_appearance: The existing controller item model inherits the redesigned block model and front texture; no item-specific transform changed.
criteria.integration_limits: Reviewed under the recommended Photon shader with Faithful 32x. The scene verifies the assembled front/side silhouette and controller UI; the roller is one supported central quarter-beam rather than a new animated mechanism.
